evals.caption: make evals in replay mode: recorded model responses, no API key, no spend. Output is the real JSON from each eval, reformatted to one line each. Runs in about 5 seconds; not sped up.

quickstart.caption: docker compose up -d --wait from a clean state, then the service list. The boot takes minutes; the clip is sped up (see speed in captions.json) and the wait is cut, not faked.
